title: 간이역
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie folk ballad. Acoustic guitar plays a steady fingerstyle pattern with alternating bass notes. A fretless bass guitar enters with melodic slides and warm, rounded tones. Soft, dry percussion consists of a shaker and subtle rimshots. Male vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate baritone register with minimal vibrato. The arrangement features a clean electric guitar playing sparse, jazz-influenced chords with a light chorus effect. 78 BPM. Key of G Major. 4/4 time signature. The mix is dry with short room reverb on the vocals and acoustic guitar.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerstyle acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
창밖을 흘러가 [shaker enters]
이름 모를 역이야
잠깐 멈춰서 아무도 안 내려 [fretless bass enters with a slide]
문만 열렸다가
닫혀버리지
간판 읽으려 해 벌써 지나가 [clean electric guitar chords]
바람만 들어와

[Chorus]
스쳐가는 거야
왜 이리 아쉬워
내려야 하는데
마음이 멈추는 거야 [rimshot]
